summary.intent: Map the cipher-box codebase and identify candidates for web/desktop E2E testing, then assess feasibility of AES-CTR streaming tests and account deletion teardown.
summary.outcome: Existing codebase docs were confirmed current (skipped re-mapping). A prioritized E2E testing roadmap was produced: 4 test suites identified (media preview, AES-CTR streaming, batch download, shared account deletion teardown), with research confirming the streaming implementation is fully testable and teardown is only wired in 1 of 12 specs.

repo: AES-CTR mode is used for media files >256KB, GCM for everything else — threshold-based selection in streaming-crypto.service.ts
Service Worker intercepts /decrypt-stream/* URLs and handles HTTP Range requests for seeking, enabling random-access decryption via BigInt counter math
deleteTestAccount() helper already exists in tests/sdk-e2e/src/fixtures/test-harness.ts (DELETE /auth/account with { confirmation: 'DELETE' }) but is only used in recovery.spec.ts
Only 1 of 12 E2E specs (recovery.spec.ts) calls deleteTestAccount() in teardown — load-test.spec.ts has the helper but doesn't invoke it
35 unit tests exist for crypto in packages/crypto but zero E2E tests cover AES-CTR streaming — Phase 12.1 left a human verification checklist that was never automated
.planning/codebase/ contains 7 structured docs (ARCHITECTURE, CONCERNS, CONVENTIONS, INTEGRATIONS, STACK, STRUCTURE, TESTING) totaling ~152KB

code.finding: deleteTestAccount() helper defined here — reusable for all spec teardowns
CTR/GCM mode selection logic — CTR for >256KB media, GCM fallback
Service Worker handling /decrypt-stream/* URL interception and HTTP Range requests for media seeking

workflow: map-codebase workflow supports Refresh/Update/Skip options when .planning/codebase/ already exists — user can selectively update individual docs
Spawning parallel research agents (one for teardown patterns, one for streaming impl) is effective for gathering multi-domain context without polluting main context

friction: Link/unlink auth methods was initially listed as high-feasibility E2E candidate but user clarified it belongs in full-lifecycle flow — requires better upfront categorization of auth-dependent features
open_items: Create shared deleteAccount teardown helper for web-e2e and wire into all 12 specs' afterAll hooks
Build media-preview.spec.ts covering PDF viewer, video player, audio player
Build streaming-playback.spec.ts covering CTR mode selection, SW interception (/decrypt-stream/* requests), seeking behavior, progress tracking 0-100%, and GCM fallback for <256KB files
Build batch-download.spec.ts covering multi-select, zip download, and zip contents verification
Decide whether to track these as a GSD milestone or proceed directly to implementation
